label: soco h4 hydro ror (KEEPER)
definition: KEEPER. soco58_warm_committed + hydro_ror_split=true: SOCO hydro plants ORNL EHA labels run-of-river / canal-conduit (17 of 45, 35 % of energy) dispatch flat at their own monthly water; reservoir plants keep full within-month shaping. 2025 hydro budget repaired from the 5-plant EIA-923 early release by hydro_backfill_year=2024. Three year-isolated shards composed at zero LP.
market_story: hydro: a run-of-river dam passes the river as it arrives and cannot store it to chase the evening peak, so SOCO's lower Coosa and Corps run-of-river projects generate around the clock at their monthly inflow; only reservoir projects (Martin, Harris, Weiss, Carters, Buford, Allatoona, Tallulah) shape into peaks. CT_PEAKER / CC_REGULAR: the hydro peak capacity that the old model borrowed from run-of-river plants is now served by gas, which is what SOCO actually dispatches at peak (measured 2025 hydro never exceeded 2.2 GW).
